name: Hundred Finance Gnosis ERC-677 transfer-hook reentrancy
summary: Hundred's Compound-fork CToken.borrow sends the underlying before recording the debt. On Gnosis the bridged USDC and WBTC are ERC677 tokens that call the recipient's onTokenTransfer, so the attacker re-entered from the hUSDC and hWBTC transfers and borrowed further markets while the comptroller still saw no debt, then left the collateral behind.
notes: The attacker's helpers posted hUSDC (and hxDAI) as collateral before the re-entrant borrows. hUSDC's collateral factor was 0 until the comptroller set it to 0.9, after its February 2022 implementation upgrade, so that listing as collateral is the latest reset.

Loss is the net outflow of the four markets in the transaction, including the 1.7M xDAI borrowed from hxDAI inside the re-entry; flash-swapped funds and the attacker's own deposits net out within the transaction. No other multi-market borrow occurred on these markets before or after the anchor.
